title: Absence Notice and Makeup Allowances, Tailwise Training
content:
24 hours is the notice period for an excused absence on every Tailwise Training course and pack. The allowances below set, course by course, what happens to a missed session: whether an absence without enough notice uses the session, how many excused group sessions may be made up and for how long, how many private sessions may be rescheduled, and whether a female in heat or a session cancelled by Tailwise is credited.

## Allowance card

| Course or pack | Notice for an excused absence (hours before session start) | Absence without enough notice uses the session | Makeup sessions allowed | Makeup window (calendar days after the last scheduled session) | Private sessions that may be rescheduled with enough notice | Female in heat excused with makeup credit regardless of notice | Session cancelled by Tailwise is credited and rescheduled |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Puppy Training 6-Week Group | 24 | Yes | 2 | 30 | 0 | Yes | Yes |
| Adult Basic Training 6-Week Group | 24 | Yes | 2 | 30 | 0 | Yes | Yes |
| Intermediate Training 6-Week Group | 24 | Yes | 2 | 30 | 0 | Yes | Yes |
| Advanced Training & CGC Prep 6-Week Group | 24 | Yes | 1 | 30 | 0 | Yes | Yes |
| Private Training 4-Session Pack | 24 | Yes | 0 | 0 | 2 | Yes | Yes |
| Private Training 8-Session Pack | 24 | Yes | 0 | 0 | 4 | Yes | Yes |

## Allowances in words

- **Group courses.** Missed group sessions that were excused may be made up in another class: up to 2 on the Puppy, Adult Basic and Intermediate Training 6-Week Group courses, and up to 1 on the Advanced Training & CGC Prep 6-Week Group. Makeups are attended within 30 calendar days after the course's last scheduled session. Group courses allow no private reschedules (0).
- **Private packs.** The private packs have no makeup allowance (0 makeups, a window of 0 days). A private session given enough notice is rescheduled instead, up to 2 times on the Private Training 4-Session Pack and up to 4 times on the Private Training 8-Session Pack.
- **Every course and pack.** Notice of 24 hours or more before the session start excuses an absence; an unexcused absence uses the session; a female in heat is excused with makeup credit whatever the notice; and a session cancelled by Tailwise is credited and rescheduled.

## Quick comparisons (hypothetical enrollments)

| Situation | Puppy Training 6-Week Group | Advanced Training & CGC Prep 6-Week Group | Private Training 8-Session Pack |
|---|---|---|---|
| Excused group sessions that may be made up | 2 | 1 | Not applicable (0) |
| Private sessions that may be rescheduled | 0 | 0 | 4 |
